title: Per-Invocation Cost Compass: attribution, export, and pricing-pattern library
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design proposal for a per-invocation cost analytics surface that complements token-level reporting. The goal is a compact, role-aware dashboard panel and exportable schema that surfaces cost breakdowns by invocation (prompt+response), model variant, route, and pricing band. This work includes a small library of UI patterns (accordion micro-breakdowns, inline sparklines, attribution connectors, and export presets) so PM/Eng can compose billing-ready views without custom frontend work.
acceptance_criteria: High-fidelity Figma prototype for desktop + compact mobile with at least two accordion states (summary + expanded micro-breakdown)
CSV/JSON export spec that includes invocation_id, route, model_variant, prompt_characters, response_tokens, hardware_multiplier, applied_pricing_band, and computed_unit_cost
Role-based visibility rules documented (admin sees raw metrics, finance sees aggregated monthly rows, developer sees per-route debug view)
Design tokens and component variants added to the console design system (badge, micro-sparkline, breakdown-row, export-button)
Sign-off from PM (product: console-cost-v2) and Eng lead for export format and performance implications
design_notes: Primary unit is 'invocation' (prompt + response). We surface both computed unit cost and normalized per-token when available to aid comparability.
Accordion pattern: summary row shows aggregated charge, expandable rows show cost contributors (model compute, I/O, KV-cache hit adjustments, quantization multiplier).
Attribution connectors: when a single invocation triggers multiple sub-requests (tool-calls, function-calls), show nested attribution with percentages and hover tooltips explaining calculation.
Export presets: 'Finance (monthly rollup)', 'Engineering (per-invocation debug)', and 'Billing (line-item compatible)'. Each preset maps to the CSV schema and retention window.
Privacy trade-off: per-invocation export can include prompt text; default export masks prompt content and requires 'billing_export' permission to include full prompts.
Performance trade-off: rendering live micro-breakdowns for large results sets will be backfilled by sampling; design shows 'live' vs 'sampled' indicator.
Accessibility: ensure color contrasts for sparkline + badge combinations and keyboardable accordion controls.

2026-03-09 - Eng review (Marta K): Backend can provide the per-invocation breakdown but producing one-by-one for large time ranges is expensive. Recommend limit by default to last 90 days and require async export job for >10k rows.
